cap.howCounted: Cap comes from active league configuration, not a hardcoded rulebook value. Used is the mirror's current cap total: active salary, configured IR/taxi contribution (snapped to $10k), and signed MFL adjustments. Room = cap minus used, in cents. Future commitments carry today’s annual salary through contract expiration; MFL does not report those years separately. No future discounts, adjustments or dead-cap charges are projected.

adjustments.howCounted: Signed amounts and descriptions exactly as MFL states them. These are MFL's recorded salary adjustments (drops, retirements and commissioner changes); credits stay negative. No description is interpreted as a computed charge.
